references.text: Zebulun is mentioned as the tenth son of Jacob, born to Leah. This verse in Genesis describes his birth and naming.
The sons of Zebulun are listed among those who went down to Egypt with Jacob, showing the tribe's origin.
Jacob's blessing over Zebulun, which prophesies about the tribe's future dwelling by the sea.
Eliab, son of Helon, is mentioned as the leader of the tribe of Zebulun in the census.
The tribe of Zebulun and its leader Eliab are mentioned in connection with the camp arrangement around the tabernacle.
The second census of the tribe of Zebulun on the plains of Moab, showing the tribe's development over time.
Moses' blessing over Zebulun, which prophesies about the tribe's prosperity and wealth.
The description of Zebulun's inheritance in the promised land, showing the fulfillment of the promises to the tribe.
